newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity eases as big share block trades.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity eases as big share block trades.

text.p: Shares in LucasVarity Plc eased as a block of 10 million changed hands on Thursday, amid market speculation that the company was starting a buy-back programme.
Sources at broker to the company Cazenove denied involvement in Thursday's deal.
Dealers at other brokerage houses said they assumed the trade was the start of the buy-back and said ABN AMRO Hoare Govett did the business.
A source at Hoare declined to comment.
A LucasVarity spokeswoman said company executives were in the U.S. and were not immediately available for comment.
"All I know is that once we've begun this we'll have to give notification within 24 hours," she said.
LucasVarity shares were 3p off at 193-1/2p and were the most actively traded in the London market.
On Tuesday LucasVarity said it plans a share buy-back starting with a three percent share repurchase in 1997 which could be repeated next year.
